description: This file defines the CommandLineFlag class, which provides a type-erased handle for accessing metadata about Abseil flags, including methods for retrieving flag information, parsing values, and managing flag state.

classes.name: CommandLineFlag
classes.description: Provides an interface for accessing and manipulating command line flags in a type-erased manner, including retrieving flag metadata, parsing values, and managing flag state.

methods.name: IsOfType
methods.description: Checks if the flag has a specific type T.

methods.name: TryGet
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the flag's value as type T, returning nullopt if unsuccessful.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the flag.

methods.name: Filename
methods.description: Returns the filename where the flag is defined.

methods.name: Help
methods.description: Returns the help message associated with the flag.

methods.name: IsRetired
methods.description: Indicates whether the flag is retired.

methods.name: DefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default value of the flag as a string.

methods.name: CurrentValue
methods.description: Returns the current value of the flag as a string.

methods.name: ParseFrom
methods.description: Sets the flag's value from a string, returning true if successful.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Copies the current flag value into a provided memory location.

methods.name: IsSpecifiedOnCommandLine
methods.description: Indicates if the flag's current value was set via command line.

methods.name: ValidateInputValue
methods.description: Validates a string input against the flag's expected value.

methods.name: CheckDefaultValueParsingRoundtrip
methods.description: Verifies that the default value can be converted to string and back.
